learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to acquire information from professional literature, databases and other resources, necessary to solve engineering tasks. The student is able to integrate the obtained information and make interpretations, as well as to draw conclusions and present justified opinions.

The student analyzes the product or element designed in terms of functions fulfilled; determines a set of material features necessary for the realization of the product; classifies their importance; determines material indicators.
The student is familiar with the major trends in materials engineering and is able to relate the acquired knowledge of surface engineering to other fields of engineering knowledge.
The student knows the basic principles of creating and developing forms of individual entrepreneurship, using the knowledge of scientific disciplines specific to the studied major.

syllabus_topics: Surface engineering in the modification of advanced structural materials and biomaterials
Fabrication and characterization of nanotube oxide films on titanium surface
Electrophoretic deposition of biopolymer coatings with metallic nanoparticles
Evaluation of the influence of surface preparation of metallic substrates on the properties of deposited coatings
Production of electrolytic and immersion coatings
Assessment of the properties of modified surfaces
assessment_rules: A passing threshold of 51.0% is required for laboratory exercises.
bibliography: F.-W. Bach, K. Mohwald, A. Laarmann, T. Wenz, Modern Surface Technology, John Wiley & Sons, 2006.
M. Kutz, Biomaterials Engineering and Design Handbook, McGraw-Hill, 2009.
Rosario Pignatello, Biomaterials Science and Engineering, InTech, Croatia, 2011.
B.D. Ratner, A.S. Hoffman, F.J. Schoen, J.E. Lemons, Biomaterials Science, Academic Press, San Diego, 1996.
Q. Chen, G.A. Thouas, Metallic implant biomaterials, Materials Science and Engineering R: Reports. 87 (2015) 157.
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
